## Change

Describe the behavior or compiler boundary changed.

## Ruby reproduction

Show the smallest Ruby source and stdin that demonstrate the behavior. State the expected CRuby output or the intended Rubast diagnostic.

## Regression evidence

Link the Cucumber scenario for observable behavior or diagnostics. Note any focused RSpec example.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. State any checks that could not run and any remaining support gap. If the accepted subset changed, link the updated documentation.
